create.name: Miranda Macpherson
create.bio:
Born in Australia, Miranda Macpherson trained at the Western Australian Academy of Performing Arts before moving to the United Kingdom. At 26, asked by her teacher Rabbi Joseph Gelberman, she established the OneSpirit Interfaith Foundation in London; over the following decade she trained and ordained more than six hundred interfaith ministers and spiritual counsellors there. After a period of practice in the cave of Sri Ramana Maharshi in south India, she settled in 2005 in the San Francisco Bay Area and now lives in San Rafael.

An interfaith minister and spiritual teacher, she offers a feminine approach to surrender and nondual realisation, built around a practice she calls Ego Relaxation. She draws on the Diamond Approach, A Course in Miracles and Sri Ramana Maharshi, combining meditation, self-inquiry, devotion and mantra with psychological integration. She leads the Living Grace Global Sangha, offers home retreats on Zoom and in-person retreats in California, Europe and the Bahamas, and teaches courses regularly on The Shift Network. Her books are The Way of Grace and Boundless Love (first published under the name Miranda Holden); she also created the Cultivating Grace card deck and has recorded two albums of mantra.

books.title: The Way of Grace: The Transforming Power of Ego Relaxation
books.author: Miranda Macpherson
books.description: Miranda's guide to Ego Relaxation, a way of meeting spiritual obstacles by softening the ego's grip rather than fighting it. It sets out the four dimensions of grace, with teachings and guided practices for meditation and inquiry. Published by Sounds True in 2018.

books.title: Cultivating Grace: Access Inner Peace, Clarity, and Joy on Your Spiritual Path [Card Deck]
books.author: Miranda Macpherson
books.description: A card deck drawing on Miranda's teachings on grace and Ego Relaxation, for daily reflection and practice. Published by Insight Editions in 2022.

books.title: Boundless Love: Transforming Your Life with Grace and Inspiration
books.author: Miranda Holden
books.description: Miranda's first book, written under her earlier name, Miranda Holden. It offers teachings on bringing grace and inspiration into everyday life. Published by Rider.

courses.title: Living in Boundless Love
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network video course on opening to boundless love and trust. Miranda guides meditations and teachings for meeting life's circumstances with more freedom.

courses.title: Life of Grace
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network video course using meditation, mantra and self-inquiry to relax control and fear. It focuses on keeping spiritual footing through life's challenges.

courses.title: Finding True Fulfillment
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network video course on finding fulfilment through inner practice rather than outer striving, with Miranda's teachings and guided practices.

courses.title: Home Retreat on Zoom: Relationships & Awakening
courses.description: A five-morning online retreat on how relationships reveal where we are free and where we contract. It includes meditation, mantra, self-inquiry in pairs, teaching and dialogue.

courses.title: Bahamas Yoga Retreat: The Way of Grace
courses.description: A residential retreat at the Sivananda Ashram Yoga Retreat in the Bahamas, teaching the practice of Ego Relaxation. Booking is through the ashram.

courses.title: European Spring Retreat
courses.description: A residential retreat in Zelhem, the Netherlands, with meditation, inquiry and teaching on grace and presence. Accommodation is booked separately with the retreat centre.
courses.price: $625 USD facilitation fee (early-bird price as listed; accommodation extra)

courses.title: California Summer Retreat: The Heart of Spiritual Surrender
courses.description: A residential retreat in Danville, California, on spiritual surrender, with meditation, mantra, inquiry and teaching.

courses.title: Living Grace Audio Program
courses.description: A monthly audio subscription of Miranda's teachings and guided practices. Members are also the first considered when places open in the Living Grace Global Sangha.

courses.title: Deepening Your Meditation Practice
courses.description: A six-module self-paced online programme built around six of Miranda's foundational meditation practices.

free_resources.title: Free Orientation Course
free_resources.description: A short free online course introducing Miranda's approach to awakening through Ego Relaxation and grace. Lessons cover what Ego Relaxation and grace are, plus pointers to her meditation and mantra practices.

free_resources.title: Ignite your Meditation Practice
free_resources.description: A free introductory video programme on starting or renewing a meditation practice, with Miranda's guidance.

free_resources.title: I AM Freedom
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guided meditation on resting in the sense of 'I am' before thought. It is also available on her YouTube channel.
